plugins.name: fandex
plugins.description: Turn a list of anime names (or a local video library) into a magazine-style PDF collection book: official covers, synopses, staff & cast, watch order, per-season spoiler guides, bookmarks and page footers. Also ships a novel domain pack: turn story notes into a character codex with a foreshadowing tracker — fully offline

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 番剧收藏册 / 设定集

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把番剧清单（或本机视频收藏）做成杂志风 PDF 收藏册：官方海报/简介/制作声优/补番顺序/逐季剧透，带书签页脚；内置 novel 领域包——把小说设定资料离线做成角色档案册与伏笔追踪手册
